Container.Name: owlet-bridge-native
Container.Overview:
Native Owlet Cam -> RTSP bridge. Enter your Owlet account in the web control panel (https://[IP]:8088); it fetches the camera key, connects to the camera over ThroughTek/Kalay (TUTK) and serves the video as RTSP via go2rtc.
SECURE BY DEFAULT: only the control panel (8088) is published. go2rtc's HTTP API stays on container loopback (it can rewrite its config and run commands, so it is never published) and RTSP/WebRTC are NOT published.
FRIGATE: put this container and Frigate on the same user-defined Docker network (once: docker network create owlet-net; then set Network Type to owlet-net on both containers). Frigate then pulls rtsp://GO2RTC_USER:GO2RTC_PASS@owlet-bridge-native:8554/owlet over that network. If Frigate uses host networking instead, add a port mapping for container port 8554 yourself and firewall it to the Frigate host only.
LIBRARIES: the proprietary TUTK .so libs are not shipped. In the web UI's "TUTK libraries" card, click "Upload & extract" and pick your Owlet .apkm/.apk.

Config.Name: Control panel
Config.Description: Web UI — enter Owlet login, upload libs, see status + logs.

Config.Name: Control panel user
Config.Description: Control-panel login (HTTP Basic auth is always on).

Config.Name: Control panel password
Config.Description: Control-panel password. Leave blank to have one generated into /config/secrets/ui.json (mode 0600); it is never printed to the log.

Config.Name: Talk-back / sound playback
Config.Description: 1 enables the endpoints that play audio out of the camera speaker (hold-to-talk, streamed sounds). Off by default.

Config.Name: go2rtc user (RTSP)
Config.Description: Username go2rtc requires for RTSP (and its API, if you ever widen GO2RTC_API_LISTEN). Loopback clients inside the container are exempt.

Config.Name: go2rtc password (RTSP)
Config.Description: Password for the RTSP URL Frigate uses: rtsp://owlet:PASSWORD@owlet-bridge-native:8554/owlet. Leave blank to have one generated into /config/secrets/go2rtc.json (mode 0600).

Config.Name: WebRTC candidate (app)
Config.Description: Only relevant if you deliberately publish WebRTC (8555) and the go2rtc API, which this template no longer does. For sub-second WebRTC to a phone/app, set this to <Unraid-LAN-IP>:<WebRTC host port>, e.g. 192.168.1.204:18555. This is the address go2rtc advertises to clients for the media connection — without it the app gets an SDP answer but no video. Leave blank if you only watch via Frigate or the LAN go2rtc UI.

Config.Name: Config (settings)
Config.Description: Persists your UI settings + camera key. Drop your Owlet .apkm here too (or upload it in the UI).

Config.Name: TUTK libs (/app/libs)
Config.Description: Folder the extracted x86_64 TUTK .so libraries live in (under x86_64/). The UI's Upload & extract writes them here.
